experiment_data.hypothesis: Magnitude-only scoring (weight L2 norm per group) at 20% sparsity. Isolates contribution of gradient signal vs weight magnitude. If post-prune accuracy near 0% (as expected from heavy early-layer pruning), confirms magnitude alone is insufficient for structured pruning — CKA/gradient signals are essential.
